native_item: Developer/proof flight controls are hidden from players behind one documented switch
port_cite_or_reason: Modern presentation only: wwwroot/dev-switch.js resolves ?dev=1 / localStorage['allegiance.dev'] (a ?dev=0 turns it off); Pages/Menu.razor renders #flight-rock, the typed #flight-waypoint/#waypoint-* form and #online-pose only when it is on. Off by default, not deleted; no game rule, wire message, limit or privilege changes
evidence: tools/p1059-browser-devcases.cjs off/on in Classic and Modern at 1920x1080 and 800x480; tools/p1059-dev-switch-tests.cjs 6/6 x3
